text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ooh, those quahog clams look delicious...! Ahaha, looks like everyone's gathered at Sanbanze.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's truly a wonderful photo.
If I were in Funabashi, surely I would—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...No, no, this won't do.
I have to focus on training...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Homesick for Funabashi,
Furioso seemed to have lost a bit of her spark...
